_note: Shriram Finance fact base, as of 30-Sep-2026 (Q1FY27 basis). Standalone company data unless stated (consolidated differs only by the associate Shriram Automall and the small subsidiary Shriram Overseas Investments since the Dec-2024 sale of Shriram Housing Finance). Sources keyed in 'sources'; each block names its source and page (printed page for annual reports, PDF page for results filings and investor updates).
